thread:
Nora: Quick sync request — VoltArc ran the recent kernel patch (v3) on their A100-ish test rig and reported a drop in perf/W for 1k token generation compared to our baseline. Can we triage? @Chen @Miguel :eyes:
Alice (VoltArc): Sharing numbers — run id 2026-03-05-VA: 80 tokens/s at 270W (0.296 tokens/W) vs our expected ~0.35 tokens/W. We applied their kernel patch + our quant profile.
Chen: Thanks Alice. Can you paste the exact launch config and the perf log tail? small suspects: mixed-precision fallback or unexpected memcpy.
Alice (VoltArc): Paste: ```./run_bench --model rp-local-v2 --seq 1024 --batch 1 --quant q4 --kern v3 --pin-cpu true``` perf tail: ```throughput: 80.2 tokens/s\npower: 270W\nlatency P50: 18ms```
Miguel: Two quick checks: 1) Was NVML sampling rate 1s or 10s? 10s averages can hide bursts. 2) Did the run include KV-cache priming? Short primed sequences reduce amortized perf/W.
Nora: Good call. Alice, what was NVML sampling and workload warmup? Also, we want to make sure this aligns with marketplace entry numbers — any variance will confuse customers.
Alice (VoltArc): NVML sampled at default 1s. Warmup: 30 steps. We used priming prompts in 50% of runs.
Chen: Ok, that explains part. If half the runs had priming, the throughput per watt measured over that window is lower due to extra token generation on short context transitions. Can you re-run with: ```--warmup 200 --no-priming``` and send the full nvml CSV?
Alice (VoltArc): Will run tomorrow morning PT. Estimated 3 runs.
bench-bot: job 2026-03-06-VA-202 completed — results uploaded to s3://redwood-partners/voltarc/2026-03-06/ (csv + telemetry).
Miguel: Also, please try the kernel v3 with the previous quant path (q8_legacy) as an A/B. Our hypothesis: v3 introduced a kernel code-path that falls back to less-efficient FP ops for q4 edge cases. If A/B shows q8 closer to baseline, that points to quant-kernel interaction.
Ivy: From Partnerships perspective — we should lock messaging for the marketplace card. If VoltArc's public numbers change, we need the final vetted artifact before we go live. Nora, can you coordinate a short embargoed slide with the numeric ranges once they re-run?
Nora: Yes. Plan: 1) VoltArc re-run w/ standardized config 2) Chen/Miguel analyze telemetry 3) Draft marketplace blurb with ranges + note on tuning knobs 4) Partner exec sync next Tue.
Alice (VoltArc): Re-run kicked off. I’ll upload nvml CSV and the full perf logs when done.
Chen: If you can also capture perf counters (L2 hit rate, copy stalls) that'd be helpful. Use our perf-collector wrapper: ```./perf-collector --counters l2_miss,memcpy_stall --out perf.json```
Miguel: After we confirm, we should add an entry to the joint calibration checklist: "energy-normalized throughput validated at seq=1024, batch=1, sampling=1s, warmup=200, no-priming, perf-counters attached." That will avoid future confusion.
Nora: Agree. Draft checklist and I’ll add to partner onboarding repo. Thanks everyone — ping me if analysis finds a regression we can't mitigate before marketplace listing. :thumbsup:
